prompt_text: Who is the best roofing company in Dallas for a roof replacement?
answer_verbatim:
There’s no single “best” roofing company that’s right for every homeowner — the best choice depends on your priorities (budget, materials, warranty, insurance/claims help, speed, reputation, etc.) and your exact location in Dallas. I can help you pick the right one. First, here are practical steps and a short vetting checklist so you can find a top contractor in your area:

What to look for (vetting checklist)
- Licenses & insurance: Verify they carry general liability and workers’ comp. Ask for certificates you can call to confirm.
- Local experience: How long have they served Dallas/Fort Worth? Do they know local building codes and HOA rules?
- Manufacturer certifications: GAF Master Elite, Owens Corning Preferred, CertainTeed Select — these mean extra training and better warranties.
- Written estimate and scope: Get a detailed, itemized written estimate (tear-off vs. overlay, underlayment, flashing, ventilation, disposal).
- Warranties: Distinguish manufacturer shingle warranty vs. contractor workmanship warranty (length and whether it’s transferable).
- References & photos: Ask for recent local references and before/after photos of full roof replacements.
- Reviews & complaints: Check Google/Yelp/Angi, and the BBB for complaints and how they were resolved.
- Payment & contract: Avoid large upfront payments. Ask about lien releases and final payment terms.
- Insurance claim experience (if applicable): If you’re filing a homeowner claim, ask about their experience working with insurers and whether they provide storm damage documentation.

Interview questions to ask each contractor
- Are you licensed/insured? Can I see certificates?
- Which shingle brands and warranty levels do you recommend and why?
- What exactly is included (venting, drip edge, ice/water shield, flashing)?
- How many days will the job take, and what’s the start date?
- Will you handle disposal and permit pulls?
- Do you provide a written workmanship warranty? Is it transferable?
- Can I see three recent local jobs and customer contact info?

How to narrow to the “best” for you
- Get at least three detailed bids and compare line-by-line.
- Prioritize companies with local references, manufacturer certifications, good online reputation, and clear workmanship warranties.
- If insurance is involved, choose contractors experienced with claims who don’t pressure you to sign immediate assignments of benefits.

If you’d like, I can:
- Walk through and compare three estimates you’ve received.
- Suggest specific Dallas-area contractors known for strong reputations (if you tell me your ZIP code and whether this is a residential or commercial job). Note: I can’t check live reviews for you now, but I can recommend how to verify them.

Tell me your ZIP code and a couple of priorities (price, best warranty, fastest schedule, insurance-handling, etc.) and I’ll help you shortlist and evaluate contractors.
